digest.component_or_area: rebar store auto-push and ticket event security scanning
propositions: A rejected tickets branch auto-push reports success locally while the push fails remotely, causing local commits to accumulate undetected for hours
The rejection reason from git stderr is captured but discarded, routing policy-decline errors onto a futile retry path instead of reporting the failure immediately
Unpushed commit backlog is never re-announced across subsequent writes, so even if a rejection is visible once it becomes invisible on write N+1 through N+122
Ticket event payloads containing secrets are never scanned on write, unlike code which is gated by gitleaks during review
The push success signal reaches only explicit fsck invocations via pull-only PUSH_PENDING detection, never the caller of any write operation
